assessments.reasoning: The survey instrument records time spent on paid work in Chapter I (e.g., Q52 and Q54 ask for usual weekly hours and actual hours worked last week). It also records time devoted to unpaid domestic and care work in Chapter K, Questions 1 to 6, recording both days per week and hours per day spent on tasks such as cooking, cleaning, clothes care, childcare, eldercare, and helping with schoolwork. However, the instrument does not include any questions or modules capturing time allocated to leisure or self-care (such as sleeping, eating, or personal care).
